description: 5.56x45mm electrothermal-chemical ammunition used by OmniCorp ETC weapons.
Test item.  A preternaturally dense, subsonic 5.56x45mm electrothermal-chemical ammunition with 1466gr AP bullets made from some extradimensional unobtainium.

5.56x45mm electrothermal-chemical ammunition with a depleted uranium 185gr subsonic armor piercing bullet.  OCG quickly made a conventional 5.56 NATO version of this round with some compromises and kept producing both before the Cataclysm.
//: 320m/s muzzle velocity. Pitiful muzzle energy for a ETC rifle round but great ballistic coefficient, terminal ballistics and very dense round make up for it.

description: This ammunition is a one-in-five mix of tracer rounds to help keep the weapon they are fired from on target.

5.56x45mm ammunition with subsonic 154gr depleted uranium bullets.  While weaker and shorter ranged than dedicated subsonic rounds such as 9x39mm, they are more compact and can cut armor like a hot knife through butter.
